page_title: REI 3-1 MAR | Reims v Marseille 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' That was a nice football moment. Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top right corner. Yehvann Diouf guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

90+6' Neal Maupay (Marseille) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
90+6' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+5' Good movement by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
90+3' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) sends a long ball forward to Jonathan Rowe, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
90+2' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
90+1' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' My Gran could have done better! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
88' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Yehvann Diouf stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.

86' Amar Dedic (Marseille) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Yehvann Diouf pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
85' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Marseille will take a free kick.
84' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. Marseille will take a free kick near the side line.
83' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
81' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Yehvann Diouf has no trouble gathering it.
79' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Amine Gouiri will be replaced by Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
79' Substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) replaces Geoffrey Kondogbia.

78' 3 - 1 Valentin Rongier (Marseille) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Yehvann Diouf is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 3:1.
78' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
77' Mory Gbane (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Marseille have a corner.
73' Samba Diawara has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sekine Hiroki (Reims) replacing Buta.
73' Substitution. Amadou Kone leaves the pitch and is replaced by John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims).
72' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
71' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:13. 5:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
71' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.

68' 3 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 3:0.
66' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
66' Luis Henrique (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
64' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) attacks the corner from Amine Gouiri in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
64' There's an opportunity for Amine Gouiri (Marseille) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
63' Luis Henrique (Marseille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. It will be a corner kick for Marseille.
62' Buta (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' The ball is cleared after Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
61' Wasted effort! Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
59' Samba Diawara has decided to make a change. Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) replaces Mamadou Diakhon.
59' Some great controlled play and passing from Marseille. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
54' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yehvann Diouf, who smothers the ball.

51' 2 - 0 Goal! Keito Nakamura plays in Mamadou Diakhon (Reims), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 2:0.
49' A cross from Luis Henrique (Marseille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Amar Dedic and Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is off.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has made a change at the break. Ismael Bennacer has come on in place of Pol Lirola (Marseille).
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner kick, but Yehvann Diouf reads it well and stops the effort.
45+6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Quentin Merlin (Marseille).
45+3' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) produces a killer pass onto Neal Maupay, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Neal Maupay (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
43' Cedric Kipre (Reims) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
40' Keito Nakamura (Reims) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Geronimo Rulli is alert and denies him with a nice save.
39' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
38' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner which is cleared.

38' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) meets a cross and produces a header towards the top left corner, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
38' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
36' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
34' Roberto De Zerbi is forced to make a change. Leonardo Balerdi is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Neal Maupay (Marseille).
33' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Keito Nakamura (Reims) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Mamadou Diakhon, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
27' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) sends a long ball forward to Adrien Rabiot, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
23' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Yehvann Diouf comfortably gathers the ball.
21' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
21' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) is penalised for a foul. Willy Delajod had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' The game is interrupted now, Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' 14:86 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
13' The foul by Junya Ito (Reims) was seen by Willy Delajod who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
11' Buta (Reims) tries to find Junya Ito, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
9' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
9' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' Mory Gbane (Reims) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Amine Gouiri (Marseille) causes Yehvann Diouf little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
7' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
3' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) sends a long ball forward to Luis Henrique, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
2' A cross by Quentin Merlin (Marseille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
2' Marseille hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
